# FORGE v4 — General-purpose Super-agent

The desktop frontend now has a six-stage Codex-style refactor, with a single
260px sidebar, inline Worker runs and UI paths for the current 50 authenticated
API routes. See the [frontend acceptance report](desktop/CODEX-REFACTOR-REPORT.md),
[API-to-UI map](desktop/API-UI-COVERAGE.md) and [desktop instructions](desktop/README.md).

FORGE is a self-built, general-purpose DeepSeek-style Super-agent desktop
application: one persistent Router conversation coordinates hidden, isolated
Workers and continuously receives events.

The current backend capability sprint adds project-focused context, bounded
specialist dependencies and expansion, real CPython unittest execution, model
microbenchmarks and progress-based stall detection. Read the
[capability report](docs/SUPERAGENT_CAPABILITY_SPRINT_REPORT.md) and
[experiment record](docs/SUPERAGENT_EXPERIMENTS.md) for current acceptance and
limitations. No frontend redesign or external Agent execution backend is added.
Current full capability acceptance has **not passed**. The resumed backend phase
completed a real autonomous L3: actual failed CPython tests, code correction,
successful exact-manifest tests, seven independent holdouts, Reviewer revision
then PASS, and reviewed delivery back to the original Router. Its 24 calls all
settled, using 232275 tokens; 222 related regression tests passed, with two
existing Windows skips. See the [resumed verification](docs/audit/superagent/capability-resumed-verification.json).
Real L1 and single-Worker L2 tasks passed on their earlier recorded source;
multi-specialist L2 and the complete combined continuity scenario remain unaccepted.
The preceding joint L2/L3 condition stopped before delivery. Correct two-project task association, distinct-task parallel Workers,
Thread pass-through and bounded relationship Recall were observed. The latest
continuation uses the user's explicit DeepSeek **100M**
model context declaration while retaining conflicting discovery metadata.
Model capacity, request affordability and cumulative spending are separate.
Later targeted probes are not task reacceptance. Exact outcomes and
source hashes are indexed in [final verification](docs/audit/superagent/final-verification.json).
Workers now receive explicit storage-relative tool paths and persisted project
identity separately from private process directories. Verified failed action
receipts persist even when no correction remains; unknown effects stay fenced.
This resumed source has targeted regression, not a new full-suite result.

`python_unittest` executes approved Python with the current OS account. It uses
an exact SHA-256 manifest, an R2 approval, a private working directory, a minimal
environment and a ten-second process-tree limit; this is not an OS sandbox.
Changed source requires another exact approval. The existing `python_test`
restricted-function tool remains available separately.

Authenticated model-intelligence APIs provide identity discovery
(`POST /api/model-intelligence/discover`), existing-record performance/health
(`GET /api/model-intelligence/{profile_id}`), and bounded text microprobes
(`POST /api/model-intelligence/benchmark`, with `profile_id` and optional
`dimensions`). Discovery does not establish capability. The six fixed probes
record source, sample size, time, usage and confidence; vision remains unknown.
These endpoints use the configured Provider and existing Registry/benchmark
records. They require no additional dependencies or environment variables.

An optional trusted `FORGE_MODEL_CALL_LIMIT` sets a positive total HTTP-attempt
ceiling for the existing workspace ledger. Settled, rejected, reserved and
unknown attempts all count; restarting Core does not refund attempts. This cap
is independent of model context capacity and cumulative Token/cost ceilings.

## Engineering status — 2026-11-16

The backend architecture now follows DeepSeek Super-agent's
persistent Router and independent Workers. The default Core delegates ordinary
conversational tasks automatically, filters environmental events, sends Thread
continuations directly to subscribed Workers, follows typed Chain of Recall
references, and supervises durable execution. Plans, Quests and approval records
are internal infrastructure. The frontend is unchanged in this correction.

Read the [architecture audit and refactor plan](docs/SUPERAGENT_REFACTOR_PLAN.md),
[product architecture](docs/PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE.md) and
[implementation and validation report](docs/SUPERAGENT_IMPLEMENTATION_REPORT.md)
for the exact implemented behavior, tests, real Provider observations and limits.
The retained `20261115T205519Z-capability-model-probes.json` records twelve real
calls, all settled, 1,414 charged tokens and unknown monetary cost. The configured
proxy reported DeepSeek and GLM identities; their upstream identity is unverified.
DeepSeek passed five of six fixed cases; GLM passed three. Each dimension has one
sample, and the exact-response contract also measures format compliance. Research
failed the strict oracle on both; GLM coding and planning responses failed the
JSON contract. Design checks a textual accessibility specification, not image
quality. Vision was unsupported and generated no call. These results do not
establish general capability scores or justify a preferred routing algorithm.

## Observed real-task results

L1 independently passed in `20261115T215924Z-capability-adaptive-45f4e4`:
one real Worker read the actual FORGE modules, wrote its analysis, passed the
model Reviewer and strict source/hash/line/quote checking. The combined run
remained failed because L2 Router admission failed. Earlier L1 attempts and
their inaccurate citation ranges remain failures.

L2 did not complete. A fixed Research → Architect condition admitted the correct
chain but its first Worker blocked after two Reviewer revisions. A subsequent
adaptive condition actually admitted Research and Architect in parallel, with
a dependent Reviewer integrator. Research passed, Architect blocked, and the
integrator never started. The absence of intermediate JSON artifact bodies
from a delivery-only review packet caused blind revisions in the fixed run;
the implementation now projects only source-verified own JSON artifacts into
that review. This fix retains original criteria, scopes and byte limits.

L3 in `20261115T221734Z-capability-continuity-300fa0` produced real code, ran
approved CPython tests, corrected an observed failure, passed the real Reviewer
and all seven independent host holdouts. It still failed full delivery
acceptance: the report cited inferred action names instead of actual test
receipt IDs. The Runtime exposed only the test output, omitting the Core receipt
identity, so the Worker could not cite the ID the checker required. This is a
Harness defect; the checker correctly rejected the report. The subsequent fix
exposes a source-bound Core receipt envelope for Python results and failed-test
feedback. It does not alter old artifacts, receipts or the failed verdict.

The final combined run observed three overlapping Worker ownership intervals
across two tasks, both Thread pass-through paths, a safe Core restart using the
same Router/Worker IDs, compaction of five real Router messages, and typed Recall
references to tasks, Workers, receipts and archives. Recall remained incomplete
at its fixed bounds. These are partial continuity observations. Both tasks were
wrongly linked to the same project, and the final reviewed completion notice
did not reach the Router. An earlier Worker claim did reach the original main
conversation; it must not be reported as the final reviewed completion.

Independent read-only supplements retain these distinctions and source hashes.
The original combined report remains failed. An approval notice exhausted its
bounded processing attempts; the final completion notice remained unprocessed
after four failures. The fixed forty-call admission ceiling blocked further
admissions. No uncertain effects were replayed, and the limit is not a Provider
outage or proof of failed model transport.

## Verification boundary and remaining work

The full `capability-backend-frozen.xml` run recorded **2533 passed, 14 failed,
3 skipped** before the last narrow fixes. Thirteen failures exactly match the
historical baseline; one was an intentional new diagnostic-event contract
conflicting with the older assertion that an invalid Router response leaves no
events. The former historical compact-prompt failure passed after redundant
wording was reduced. The atomicity regression now explicitly verifies unchanged
Router state, no messages/Quests and exactly the safe diagnostic events; it does
not permit scheduling or user-turn side effects. Original failed XMLs are kept.

Later targeted regressions cover the team error hints, receipt visibility,
specialist review, per-task/final accounting and the optional atomic HTTP-attempt
ceiling. See `final-verification.json` for final source hashes and exact suite
counts. Overlapping targeted counts must not be summed as a full suite.

The final full regression on the final production source recorded **2587 passed,
13 failed, 3 skipped**, one existing Starlette deprecation warning, in 556.83
seconds (`capability-backend-final.xml`). All thirteen failures match historical
baseline cases; there are no new failed cases. The diagnostic-event contract
test passes. One already collected project test later received only an import
spacing/unused-variable lint cleanup, and its eleven cases were rerun and passed.
All 59 modified/new Python files pass Ruff; backend/README/docs diff checks pass.
This regression result does not turn the failed live acceptance into a pass.

The final two real Provider probes both recovered exact Python test receipt IDs,
execution states and candidate hashes from the corrected projection. They use
the original historical database read-only and execute no old Worker or test.
Task/diagnostic use totals 160 admitted calls, 159 settled and one old reserved
attempt with unknown outcome; known usage is 1355207 Token. The separate twelve
microprobe calls used 1414 Token. Monetary cost remains unknown. No further real
calls are made beyond the fixed ceiling.

The model window defaults to the Registry declaration. Cumulative allocation,
request affordability, compaction protocol and evidence limits remain separate
checks. `context_budget` was historically a broad external error code, so it
cannot establish that a Provider's declared context window was exhausted.

Unfinished acceptance includes a successful multi-specialist L2, a full L3
delivery after the receipt-envelope fix, correct two-project associations across
the complete live scenario, final reviewed Router notifications and recap, and
a controlled successful single/fixed/dynamic comparison on frozen source.
Dynamic expansion, replacement, failover and stall recovery have targeted
programmatic/scripted coverage; this experiment set does not establish their
live long-term success rates. No superior policy or general capability ranking
is claimed. Tools retain their existing governance; arbitrary shell execution,
OS sandboxing and unrestricted package installation are not introduced.

## Current status

The bounded real-task experiment set ended with partial observations and failed
full acceptance. Per-task ceilings remained fixed in the
[Sprint report](SUPERAGENT_CAPABILITY_SPRINT_REPORT.md). L1 has an independently
passing task; L2 did not complete; L3's real code passed holdouts but its reported
receipt binding did not. No comparative advantage is established.

## Preserved first failure and corrected context metadata

The first adaptive run `20261115T210429Z-capability-adaptive-b78221`
failed after real source reads. Both Workers stopped at `context_budget` and L2
did not form the required specialist team. The original report and separate
read-only supplemental accounting are retained: 24 calls settled, no inferred
success. Final diagnostic reads originally raised SQLite OperationalError
without recording its code; later read-only diagnostics succeeded. The cause
of that transient I/O failure remains unknown.

The operator clarified that this DeepSeek Provider advertises **100M** context.
The old 65536 acceptance profile was an obsolete conservative host assumption,
not the provided model capacity. More significantly, the delegation path used
one estimated request's input plus output (73728 tokens) as the cumulative
Worker allocation, then reduced the request window by its remaining amount.
Compaction consumed that allocation further. Subsequent runs use the explicit
Provider-declared context metadata and separate request estimates from
cumulative allocations. This is not a measured upstream maximum. The fixed
500000-token/32-call/900-second per-task and total 160-call/2500000-token
experiment ceilings remain unchanged, including retained failures. No prior
failed run is reopened or reclassified as successful.

The next `/models` metadata inspection returned `context_length=1000000`,
`max_input_tokens=1000000` and `max_output_tokens=128000`. This conflicts with
the spoken 100M value. Real acceptance now uses the actual 1M declaration,
while tests cover arbitrary valid large Registry windows including 100M. The
first run after the clarification retained the explicitly configured 100M value
and failed Router decision validation; it is preserved separately. Provider
discovery now retains allowlisted declaration fields and their provenance,
without overwriting existing operator profiles or interpreting declared limits
as measured capability. Runtime output allowance remains 8192 in acceptance;
the Provider's larger output maximum does not enlarge that spending allowance.

## Retained capability failures before final verification

| Run suffix | Real calls | Outcome and observed limitation |
| --- | ---: | --- |

These six attempts consumed **86 task calls: 85 settled and one retained reserved
attempt with unknown outcome**, plus 648087 known charged tokens. The separate
twelve-call microprobe is not included. Monetary cost and the unresolved attempt's
actual usage remain unknown. Failures count against the unchanged experiment
ceiling; they are not replaced by successful retries in a reported denominator.

The observed defects received bounded fixes and targeted regression checks.
Router reflection now sees the rejected response transiently; raw rejected text
is not persisted in diagnostic events. A Worker can recover a provably
unexecuted path/source-read error and resume a batch through individual exact
R2 approvals. No unknown operation is replayed. Source packets now include a
derived, hash-attributed numbered presentation; original content, source hashes
and strict citation checking are preserved. This addresses input presentation
and does not retroactively correct an old report.

Final verification additionally rechecks per-task budgets after recap/draining
and binds L3 test claims to current-code receipts. Host artifact checks, actual
Worker execution and model Reviewer verdicts remain separate evidence classes.

## Final bounded observations

| Run | Calls / known Token | Real outcome |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `adaptive-45f4e4` | 14 settled / 149699 | L1 Core/Reviewer/strict citation checker passed. L2 team extra-field then topology validation failed; L3 was not submitted. |

| `receipt-visibility` | 2 settled / 2437 | Real DeepSeek responses extracted exact receipt identity/state/code hashes from the corrected Core projection. A targeted historical-data diagnostic, not a Worker or task rerun. |

Across nine task attempts plus the final targeted diagnostic, **160 calls** were
admitted: 159 settled and the one earlier reserved/unknown attempt. Known charged
usage is **1355207 Token**; unknown usage and currency cost are not imputed. The
separate microprobe remains 12 settled calls / 1414 Token. No additional live
calls are made after the fixed task/diagnostic ceiling is reached.

intervals and two overlapping tasks; ownership is not a CPU-concurrency measure.
Both Thread follow-ups passed through without an extra `router_trigger` model
call. Host fault injection restarted the same Core state at an R2 wait, compacted

These are engineering diagnostics, not a controlled estimate of team-policy
quality. Full success, latency/cost advantage, causal recovery efficacy and

# Super-agent Capability Sprint

Date: 2026-11-16. Base: `57a162d31f9b559353fecbde61f95dd72f878abd`.

## Resumed result — real L3 passed, overall acceptance incomplete

After reading the failed chat and existing evidence, this phase corrected two
observed Harness defects: ambiguous storage/project/private-cwd paths and lost
failed receipts when correction was exhausted. It preserves the existing
architecture, Provider configuration, explicit 100M model declaration, tool
permissions, cumulative budgets, retry counts and historical unknown effects.
The pre-run [protocol](audit/superagent/capability-resumption-protocol.json)
binds a new 351-file freeze and exactly one development sample, at most 29 new
attempts within the original continuation ceiling of 160.

`REDACTED` passed all original L3 checks.
One hidden real Worker used the correct tool paths, wrote code and unchanged
visible tests, observed an actual failed CPython test, revised its code, and
obtained successful exact-manifest test receipts. Seven independently executed
holdouts passed. The final candidate hash matches the successful receipts cited
by development.json. Independent review requested one revision and then passed;
the reviewed completion reached the original persistent Router. Direct Thread
continuation also passed. Core drained with no new unknown effect or usage.

All 24 model calls settled; known usage was 232275 tokens and monetary cost
remains unknown. Continuation totals are 155 attempts, 153 settled real upstream
calls, two historical injected rejections, and 1510691 known tokens. Including
historical unknown rejection reservations gives 1562321 charged-or-reserved
tokens, below the unchanged 2600000 ceiling. The older original task phase and
12 microprobes remain separate; no unknown operation was replayed. This fresh
sample ended once and is not followed by another real probe.

The combined relevant regression passed **222 cases, with 2 existing Windows
skips**. Its component suites overlap and must not be summed. Ruff and diff
checks passed. There is no new full-backend result for this source; the earlier
2795/14/3 full result and 61-case contract correction retain their original
attribution. Tests separately cover exhausted repair/steps, corrupted receipts,
unknown-effect fences, cross-project isolation and three Provider wire formats.

Full Super-agent acceptance remains incomplete: successful multi-specialist L2
and complete combined two-project restart/compaction/Recall/delivery are still
required. This one sample establishes neither general correctness nor a best
team strategy. See [resumed verification](audit/superagent/capability-resumed-verification.json)
and [current index](audit/superagent/final-verification.json). The sections below
preserve the preceding closed stages and their failed outcomes.
Branch: `codex/phase1-continuous`. Status: implementation advanced; full task acceptance **not passed**.
No frontend work, architecture replacement, Git push or external Agent backend.

## Final frozen-source outcome

Full capability acceptance **failed**. The final 345-file condition
`20261116T002629Z-capability-continuity-e02ee2` admitted exactly 28 real calls,
all settled, 290808 known tokens. It correctly created L2 in beta and L3 in
alpha; distinct-task Worker ownership overlapped, and both subscribed Threads
passed follow-up events directly without another Router decision.
# Super-agent experiments

Date: 2026-11-16. Capability Sprint base: `57a162d`.

## Resumed development condition — 2026-11-16

One new development sample was fixed before calls by the
[resumption protocol](audit/superagent/capability-resumption-protocol.json).
It used a fresh isolated workspace, the already authorized Provider and the
explicit 100M context declaration. The allowance was 29 new attempts within
the remaining original 160-attempt continuation ceiling, 500000 tokens,
unchanged 8192/4096 Worker/Router output limits and zero Gateway retries.
The 900-second driver observation deadline allows up to 130 seconds of
settlement drain; it is not a trusted hard admission cutoff at second 900.

Real run [REDACTED](audit/superagent/REDACTED.json)
passed after 24 settled calls and 232275 tokens, in 138.865 seconds including
shutdown. It exercised actual file tools, one failed CPython test followed by
code correction and successful tests, one Reviewer revision followed by PASS,
Thread pass-through, and reviewed delivery to the original Router. Independent
host checks passed seven holdouts and bound final code hashes to real successful
test receipts. All calls and effects settled; cost remains unknown.

This sample uses corrected path presentation and exhausted-failure receipt
retention. It is a new-source corrective condition, not a repeated controlled
sample or proof that a team strategy is superior. No restart or Router-history
compaction was injected in development mode. Multi-specialist L2 and full joint
continuity remain unaccepted. The [resumed verification](audit/superagent/capability-resumed-verification.json)
records targeted regression (222 passed, two Windows skips); no new full-suite
claim is made. Historical failure reports and the exact old index remain intact.

The [reproducible comparison table](audit/superagent/capability-continuation-comparison.md)
binds each original report and source/material hash. The same-source single
L2 passed (13 calls / 154299 tokens); fixed L2 failed before Architect execution
(15 calls / 170378 tokens). Different-source dynamic joint conditions are
listed separately. One sample, harness failures and incomplete downstream work
prevent a team-policy ranking or general superiority claim.

## Latest closed continuation

The [predeclared protocol](audit/superagent/capability-continuation-protocol.json)
completed once per condition. The [closure](audit/superagent/capability-continuation-closure.json)
binds all five immutable reports and the 338-file source freeze. L1 and single
L2 passed; continuity and fixed L2 failed. Native replacement after one explicit
503 injection occurred, but fallback completion failed with an unknown tool
outcome. There is no natural-Provider-failure success claim. Total: 50 attempts,
49 settled real upstream calls, one injected rejection, 515841 known tokens;
unknown rejection usage, cost and tool effect remain unknown without refunds.

The user declaration of **100M** now takes precedence for DeepSeek model

# FORGE desktop

React 18、Tauri 2、TypeScript、Vite 与分层原生 CSS。保留每个工作空间的一条长期对话：Router 负责协调，Worker 使用私有执行上下文，后台任务和交付回到同一条对话。

```powershell
npm test
npm run build
npm run dev -- --port 5173
```

没有新增应用依赖。原生调试沿用现有 Core runtime 设置；当前锁定 Rust 依赖在本机使用已安装的 Rust 1.90 验证。Git 变更预览需要 PATH 中存在 Git。

## 导航、任务与设置

普通布局使用 260px 单栏侧边栏与 36px 标题栏，可完全收起侧栏；760px 以下侧栏为浮层。标题栏提供返回/前进、文件/编辑/视图/帮助菜单和组件心跳入口。HTML 保留 16px rem 基准，UI 使用独立 14px 字号，`--spacing:.25rem` 解析为 4px。当前真实工作空间作为可展开项目，只有一个对话入口；置顶与最近分组不会伪造额外会话。项目发现只读展示后端已发现目录，未提供跨空间切换、项目 CRUD 或目录授权。Ctrl+, 打开设置。

后台任务按明确的 project/workspace ID、路径或 metadata 归属分组；缺省归当前工作空间，不从任务名称猜项目。同名但不同 ID 的项目保持独立。组内需处理、运行任务优先，已结束任务默认折叠；支持搜索项目名称/路径/任务、筛选与键盘导航。计数仅表示已加载记录，轮询保留选择、折叠和滚动。

`/api/settings` 与任务读取提供 version 1 的 `project_context`：当前 workspace 的 ID、名称、根目录及默认项目键，明确 `scope=current_workspace`。侧栏与任务共用 `projectContext.ts`，同时解析 Core 实际存储的 JSON 字符串 metadata 与对象。metadata 仅用于分组，不授予目录权限；契约明确不支持跨空间切换或项目 CRUD。

设置按现有功能分为三组九项：常规、键盘快捷键、模型库、运行配置、用量与预算、记忆、触发器、供应商凭据、备份与恢复。采用左导航与右内容两栏，窄屏切换为顶部横向导航。分类栏通常为 288px，内容列最大 768px（含内部 20px 边距），导航行 30px、实际标签 14px/21px，设置行标签 13px/18.5714px、说明 12px/16px。表单选择 compact 输入与 md 按钮变体，28px 高、13px 字号。模型档案保留新增、编辑、启停，能力、价格与技术记录按需展开，未知值不推断为支持。

模型发现与固定样例测量使用现有 Provider；只有点击按钮才会调用，测量会消耗预算且失败不自动重试。触发器提供事件源注册、事件接收、定时任务和文件监听语义表单。后端只提供 pending 事件列表，UI 不将其冒充全部源、定时任务或监听清单；创建回执仅保留于本次打开页面。

运行配置同页提供供应商连接、Router 与 API Key；已有连接的标识和能力声明默认折叠，首次启用且缺少必填标识时自动展开。预算、并发和网络范围在高级设置中。配置与密钥仍分别保存：配置保持版本确认，保存密钥沿用系统凭据库及重启流程；“检查是否存在”只检查本机凭据，不冒充模型连接测试。旧“供应商凭据”入口继续可用。API Key 仅存于密码输入控件，既不进入配置 JSON，也不进入浏览器存储。

## 对话与文件工作区

聊天默认最大 736px 居中，正文 14px/430 字重，会话项间距 16px，用户气泡圆角 12.5px，助手正文无气泡。Composer 采用方案 B，保留 textarea、IME 和请求 ID 重试语义；外框圆角 15px，与消息列等宽。输入栏位于滚动区底部的绝对定位层，通过 ResizeObserver 实测高度预留阅读空间，空白层允许指针穿透。底部提供上下文、权限和模型入口；模型选择进入运行配置预填，保存并重启 Core 后生效。当前没有会话临时模型、分支切换或推理强度 API，因此不提供无效控制。

右侧 Agent 卡片承载子智能体概览、变更和来源，取代旧 Worker 浮层。卡片按本机原生资源核对为 300px 宽、16px 圆角、16px 彩色花形头像；使用原生黄/粉/绿 SVG 的明暗版本，同一 Worker 在卡片和对话中保持一致。宽屏默认显示，1180px 以下默认隐藏，工具栏 Agent 按钮可打开浮层；文件预览或任务抽屉打开时暂时隐藏卡片。来源仅来自已加载、真实成功的文件读取回执；后台进程仅展示已记录且正在运行的真实命令。

对话按用户消息划分显示区间，执行过程在同一阅读列中交错呈现助手进度、灰色工具摘要和子智能体动态。相邻同状态的子智能体事件合并为多头像与姓名句子，工具摘要点击后才展开原始命令、文件和回执。历史动态按真实事件显示；`worker.result` 表示已返回结果，仍需区分后续验证；没有生命周期事件的 activity 快照明确显示“当前状态”，不伪造开始或完成时刻。工具保留原来的时间顺序，每个回执仅显示一次，不再集中搬到子智能体条目内。

出现可外置的尾回复后，未操作的过程默认收起，最终回复及文件变更总结保持可见。手动展开过程或内部详情后，轮询和完成不会将其收起。当前消息 API 没有明确的最终回复通道；外置使用尾部普通助手回复且本显示区间没有已知活动运行的规则，任务通知和标记为 commentary 的消息仍在过程内，这只是显示分组，不判断任务已完成。折叠头显示“用时 X 分钟 Y 秒”：从本显示区间的用户请求时间起算，缺失时使用最早有效记录时间；活动运行每秒更新，结束后固定为尾回复或最后持久记录的时间差。它表示该区间的墙钟时间，不是模型推理或计费时长。记录缺少有效起止时间时显示“用时 — 分钟 — 秒”，单条无终止时间的运行快照不填零。点击右侧运行会打开外层过程并定位精确 Run 的详情。任务、计划、团队、审批和活动仍使用右侧抽屉，聊天、草稿、回执缓存与阅读位置继续保留。失败、未知与模拟标记独立显示，不生成思考正文。

会话及记忆页提供 Chain of Recall 引用卡，按真实引用读取内容和关联分页；活动抽屉可按事件序号读取事件流。顶栏心跳按服务端 Unix 秒和超时区分正常、过期、未知和读取失败。

命令卡按原始桌面 bundle 实现 Shell 标题、命令/输出分别复制、144px 输出独立滚动、右下真实退出状态；圆角 12.5px、边框 0.8px，长命令可完整展开。文件写入/修订展开后直接读取精确不可变回执，在会话内显示路径、增删数和 diff，不必先打开右栏。diff 为 12px/21.6px、单行号、4px 红绿色条与整行底色，最大高 240px；原/新行号来自实际 unified diff hunk。折叠时不读取，展开后在内存保留回执及双轴阅读位置，轮询和活动拆组不重置；连接/空间/代次变化清除缓存。完整历史入口继续保留。

活动组中真实成功的写入/修订按路径去重，使用独立 turn diff 块，默认显示 3 个文件，可展开更多并预览；增删数只来自实际加载的不可变回执。刷新、活动独立轮询插入和结束折叠保留阅读锚点；底部阅读时继续跟随。历史事件与最新执行状态区分，记录未加载时明确提示。

工具栏的文件按钮，或对话里的文件引用，可打开右侧预览。文档在左、文件树在右；树内同时提供已更改目录与所有文件，过滤针对已加载文件，状态来自真实 Git。支持文件标签、面包屑、预览/源码切换、键盘切换/关闭、可拖动和键盘调整的分隔条、独立滚动及刷新。展开按钮可将预览扩展为完整文件工作区，保留聊天 DOM、草稿和阅读位置。开合继续使用用户要求的 150ms 宽度/透明度过渡，退出保留文档 DOM 并禁用隐藏控件，支持快速反向切换与减少动效。窗口缩放按原生 Root.H/Kg/g3 的断点变化收起/恢复右栏：工作区（含可见左导航）跨到 960px 以下且项目栏打开，或跨到 720px 以下时收起，放宽后恢复一次；手动开关清除恢复记录，连续更窄的断点按原文覆盖当时开关状态。展开意图、文件标签和滚动继续保留。FORGE 没有原生的 route/owner lease/tab retain 特例；720px 以下主动打开文件仍为全宽单面板，水平导航也是 FORGE 适配。

预览宽度直接移植原生 DUYS 的默认值和归一化比例算法。以实际主区宽 W 和 workspace 行高 H 计算 `max(320,min(1.6H,W−500),min(640,W−352))`，regular 区间为 320 至 `max(320,W−352)`。首个真实测量后冻结比例，窗口缩放继续使用同一比例；展开时全宽，恢复后沿用原比例。分隔器覆盖布局，不占额外列宽；双击恢复当前默认宽，拖到 160px 以下关闭，越界至聊天不足 160px 时展开。移除了此前 660px/41–64%、1424px 自动收栏和 1136px 单面板的自行校准规则。

文件树按原生 U5mJ/gbrq 共用一个初始 250px 宽度，夹在 200px 与父宽 60% 之间，CSS 额外限制 max-width 60%。左边缘可拖动，拖至 100px 以下隐藏；普通与完整工作区共享该状态。为支持现有“文件”入口，FORGE 的文件请求仍自动显示树。普通与展开状态采用 14px 标签/操作文字、13px 文件名、30px 树行、16px 文件图标、48px 文件工具栏。BaseFileTree 的实际覆盖为横向 padding 3px、gap 5px、层级间距 8.75px；移植 20 类 DMvp 内联文件 SVG、目录 chevron、悬停层级线和 20px 状态框。新增/修改/删除分别为原生 sectioned 树的 #00a240/#0285ff/#e02e2a，普通选中文字为正文色。原增删计数保留在无障碍文本中。

文件树开关位于工具栏最右侧，标签栏的“＋”使用现有文件选择能力：浏览器打开文件选择器，原生展开目录树并聚焦过滤。源码查找默认收起，通过“查找文件内容”或源码区 Ctrl+F 展开；Enter/Shift+Enter 定位，Escape 关闭并回到源码。窄预览在 560px 以下将工具栏文字折为图标，保留原可访问名称；这些入口安排是结合用户截图的 FORGE 适配，未增加原应用专属的编辑器启动接口。

- 源码：只读、行号、基本词法着色、按需展开的查找、复制、横向滚动/换行。非换行视图虚拟化；超过 5000 行关闭换行，避免长文件拖慢界面。
- Markdown：16px/24px 正文，文档内边距 12px 16px；预览/源码切换保留阅读位置，相对链接打开同空间文件。HTML 不执行，外链图片不加载，危险 URL 不渲染。
- PDF：使用实际读取字节创建并回收 Blob URL，交给内置查看器提供多页、缩放、查找和页面适配；不支持内嵌时提供明确说明与下载。
- Git：显示当前工作空间的真实变更与差异，支持子目录、重命名、删除、新文件、无 HEAD 仓库；工作树与 HEAD 相同但暂存区有修改时明确显示暂存差异。Git 读取不写索引。
- 工作空间变更与对话文件记录分别标明口径；对话汇总仅含已加载记录中真实成功的文件写入。
- 历史更改：展开成功文件写入/修订记录后选择“记录的更改”，按精确工具回执读取历史 diff、增删数与基础版本。历史标签与当前文件标签独立；相同文件的多个回执可并排切换。加载后增删数回填对应活动行。刷新、关闭重开保留阅读位置，连接/空间/代次变化清除旧内容。

历史数据由独立认证只读接口 `GET /api/artifacts/receipts/{receipt_id}/diff` 提供，验证完整执行/版本回执链，使用不可变 `action_intents` 中保存的正文，绝不以当前文件或 Git 补作历史基线。单版本上限 256 KiB/2000 行，最多 64 个版本、累计 4 MiB，diff 上限 512 KiB；过大返回 422，不可用/敏感路径/损坏回执返回不含内部细节的 404。模拟来源始终标注。来源跳转表示“关联任务的请求”，不证明该请求直接导致每个历史 run；未加载消息有明确提示，不冒充精确聊天轮次归属。

浏览器开发模式点击“文件”，选择本地目录或文件；不会把浏览器测试数据当作工作空间文件。目录导入移除共同顶层目录，保留相对文件引用。导入文件没有 Git 历史。

## 只读原生命令

四个命令只允许 main 窗口，绑定 CoreHost 启动时固定的工作空间根目录：

| 命令 | 参数 | 返回 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| workspace_files_list | path，根目录为空字符串 | 当前目录条目 |
| workspace_file_read | 工作空间相对 path | 文本或 PDF/图片字节与元数据 |
| workspace_changes | 无 | 当前范围 Git 状态及可用增删数 |
| workspace_file_diff | 相对 path | 真实差异、二进制/截断标志及 scope |

路径穿越、绝对路径、符号链接/重解析目录被拒绝；Windows 文件打开后再次核验句柄路径。文本仅 UTF-8、最大 2 MiB；PDF/图片最大 24 MiB；目录最多 5000 项；Git 输出最大 4 MiB、读取时限 8 秒。错误明确显示。新命令不执行 Worker 工具，也不改变审批、授权、维护和写入流程。Core 时间线仅补充 file_revise 的工具名和同规则过滤后的相对路径，不返回原始正文或输出。

## 对话执行过程纠正

用户补充两张原生对话参考图后，本轮将过程记录改为同一列中的工具摘要、助手进度及多头像子智能体动态，去掉默认露出的状态卡与多层详情。对照本机原生 `AQ20` 的多头像生命周期句子、`SISf/QypQ` 的过程与最终回复分离、`XSEO/getw` 的折叠头和 `IgqH` 的工具摘要。工具行与子智能体行均使用 16px 图标、普通字重及低对比度文字，鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦后出现展开箭头。

## 对话执行过程纠正

用户补充两张原生对话参考图后，本轮将过程记录改为同一列中的工具摘要、助手进度及多头像子智能体动态，去掉默认露出的状态卡与多层详情。对照本机原生 `AQ20` 的多头像生命周期句子、`SISf/QypQ` 的过程与最终回复分离、`XSEO/getw` 的折叠头和 `IgqH` 的工具摘要。工具行与子智能体行均使用 16px 图标、普通字重及低对比度文字，鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦后出现展开箭头。

`processTimeline.ts` 仅建立按用户消息划分的显示区间，逐条保留持久化事件位置；工具不再按最新 Worker 快照移动到运行起点，历史事件不被当前状态重写。相邻同状态的生命周期事件合并头像与姓名；`worker.result` 显示“已返回结果”，不会把等待验证冒充最终完成。仅有 activity 快照时显示“当前状态”，模型、供应商、步数、事件时间和任务入口在详情内。右栏点击运行可自动打开过程并定位精确 Run；过程或内部记录被用户操作后，完成与轮询保留手动展开。

尾部普通助手回复在当前显示区间没有已知活动运行时外置，最终回复后保留真实成功写入的文件总结；任务通知及 commentary 标记的消息不提升为最终回复。当前后端没有 final 通道或真实轮次耗时，因此这属于显示启发式，不能证明任务完成或精确轮次归属。折叠头显示“执行过程”，不根据首末工具时间拼造用时。文件增删总数仅在各文件回执数据完整时显示，没有添加无效的撤销功能。

已修复在右栏打开运行后、该运行结束时父过程误收起的问题。新增浏览器场景检查顺序、完成收起与手动保留、单次精确回执读取、内部详情缓存和 DOM、历史前插与草稿、390px 输入，以及迟到进度插入时阅读锚点 20px→20px。现有工具风险回归继续检查失败、未知、模拟、非零退出码及完整长命令。

最终复验：`npm test` **37/37 通过**（含 6 项新过程模型测试），`npm run build` 通过，`git diff --check` 通过。本轮 **11 组浏览器回归通过，均无未捕获异常**：过程展示 28 项、Agent 面板 36 项、会话 88 项、整体布局 20 项、任务控制 17 项、精确内联 diff 27 项、风险 17 项、文件总结 15 项、历史版本 29 项，以及发送 smoke 与活动阅读锚点。此前入口因新增过程折叠而隐藏的测试已适配为真实展开操作，保留业务断言。

# HTTP API 与前端入口对照

核查日期：2026-11-16。以当前 `backend/src/forge_api/main.py` 的 HTTP 路由声明和 `desktop/src/` 调用点为准，按 HTTP 方法分别计数：**50 条 `/api/*` 路由，加 1 条 `/health`**。Prompt 中的 48 条和未接入清单来自较早版本。

本表记录接口的实际 UI 入口与实现位置。具备入口不等于所有状态都已通过真实 Provider 验收；浏览器合成数据验收、单元测试和真实 Core/Provider 联调须分别记录。原生 `invoke` 命令、凭据库和文件工作区能力不属于此 HTTP 路由计数。

所有 `/api/*` 调用继续经过 [api.ts](src/api.ts) 的原有 `request<T>(connection, path, init)`，会话 Bearer 保留在内存中。UI 不改鉴权、后端请求模型、审批来源、版本与摘要绑定。

## 会话、活动、运行状态与记忆（13 条）

| # | 方法与路径 | UI 触达路径 | 实现文件 | 实际限制 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `GET /api/conversation` | 长期对话；加载更早消息；连接校验 | [useConversationFeed.ts](src/hooks/useConversationFeed.ts)、[api.ts](src/api.ts) | 读取当前工作空间的一条长期对话，按 `before` 分页。 |
| 2 | `POST /api/conversation/message` | Composer 发送；失败消息重试 | [useConversationSend.ts](src/hooks/useConversationSend.ts) | 使用真实 `request_id`；相同内容重试保留原 ID，网络失败不宣称请求未执行。 |
| 3 | `GET /api/timeline` | 会话中的工具调用、子智能体事件、历史加载 | [useConversationFeed.ts](src/hooks/useConversationFeed.ts)、[ChatTimeline.tsx](src/ChatTimeline.tsx) | 保留分页与历史事件来源；不生成缺失的工具输出或思考时长。 |
| 4 | `GET /api/activity` | 右侧 Agent 卡片、会话子智能体条目；运行活动抽屉 | [AgentPanel.tsx](src/components/AgentPanel.tsx)、[ConversationRuntime.tsx](src/ConversationRuntime.tsx)、[useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts) | 独立轮询约 6 秒；详情按 `run_id` 绑定，读取失败清除陈旧当前状态。已记录步数和运行成功不代表任务完成。 |
| 5 | `GET /api/events` | 运行活动 → 事件流 | [EventFeed.tsx](src/components/EventFeed.tsx) | 按 `after` 序号轮询；每批 100 条，本次查看最多保留最近 500 条。不是 SSE/WebSocket 订阅。 |
| 6 | `GET /api/settings` | 常规、运行配置；Composer 当前模型；工作空间识别 | [useConversationFeed.ts](src/hooks/useConversationFeed.ts)、[useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts)、[OperatorSettings.tsx](src/OperatorSettings.tsx) | 区分当前活动配置与已保存配置，不把已保存模型当作正在运行的模型。 |
| 7 | `POST /api/settings` | 设置 → 运行配置 → 保存 | [OperatorSettings.tsx](src/OperatorSettings.tsx)、[useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts) | 必须携带 `expected_revision`；保存后重启 Core 才生效。不会重置既有预算账本。 |
| 8 | `GET /api/restore-status` | 写入锁定横幅；设置 → 备份与恢复 | [useConversationFeed.ts](src/hooks/useConversationFeed.ts)、[WorkspaceInspector.tsx](src/components/WorkspaceInspector.tsx) | 恢复锁定不会由 UI 自动解除；记录损坏或不可用时保留人工复核要求。 |
| 9 | `GET /api/budget` | 设置 → 用量与预算；运行配置 | [useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts)、[BudgetOverview.tsx](src/BudgetOverview.tsx) | 区分已确认用量、预留和未结算状态；未知费用不视为零。 |
| 10 | `GET /api/memory` | 设置 → 记忆；侧栏记忆入口 → 搜索/加载更多 | [useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts)、[WorkspaceInspector.tsx](src/components/WorkspaceInspector.tsx) | 使用后端 `cursor`；展示来源、冲突、有效期与可信度。 |
| 11 | `POST /api/memory/{memory_id}/revoke` | 记忆记录 → 撤销记忆 | [WorkspaceInspector.tsx](src/components/WorkspaceInspector.tsx) | 只对可撤销的有效记忆标识展示入口；需用户确认；后台仍负责有效性检查。 |
| 12 | `GET /api/recall` | 会话 → 引用与来源；记忆页；事件详情的关联引用 | [RecallCard.tsx](src/components/RecallCard.tsx) | 使用真实 `reference`、内容偏移与关联偏移；每页内容有字节上限，历史陈述不作为授权或正确性证明。 |
| 13 | `GET /api/runtime/health` | 顶栏 → 运行健康 | [RuntimeHealth.tsx](src/components/RuntimeHealth.tsx)、[runtimeHealth.ts](src/runtimeHealth.ts) | 根据 `last_seen`、`timeout_seconds` 与组件状态判断心跳；连接成功不代表模型和权限已就绪。 |

## 任务、计划、团队与 Worker（15 条）

任务是长期对话的后台上下文。侧栏后台任务或会话内子智能体条目的“查看任务”打开右侧任务抽屉；不创建新的用户会话。

| # | 方法与路径 | UI 触达路径 | 实现文件 | 实际限制 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | `GET /api/quests` | 后台任务列表、会话任务关联；加载更多 | [useConversationFeed.ts](src/hooks/useConversationFeed.ts)、[QuestWorkspace.tsx](src/QuestWorkspace.tsx) | 仅对已加载记录分组/计数，保留 `before` 分页。 |
| 15 | `GET /api/quests/{quest_id}` | 未加载的关联任务；任务操作与历史 → 子智能体提案 | [useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts)、[QuestControls.tsx](src/components/QuestControls.tsx) | 返回 `{quest, workers}`；这里的 `workers` 为会话提案/身份记录，实时执行信息另读 `/api/activity`。 |
| 16 | `GET /api/quests/{quest_id}/plan` | 后台任务 → 执行计划；团队页；操作后刷新 | [useWorkspaceInspector.ts](src/hooks/useWorkspaceInspector.ts)、[QuestWorkspace.tsx](src/QuestWorkspace.tsx) | 没有计划时 404 显示暂无计划；不会把成功操作后的无计划状态误报成操作失败。 |
